tables.title: Remote Control
rows: Tunable white control on the LBI G2 w/ IRWC remote. Keys on the remote: power, RESET, G1, G2, CCT+ / CCT- step keys, LM+ / LM- brightness keys, six CCT preset keys (2700K/3000K/3500K/4000K/5000K/5700K) and PW1-PW4
notes: Key labels (CCT+/CCT-, LM+/LM-, G1/G2, PW1-PW4) are read from the remote illustration; the catalog text does not describe their functions

footnotes: * Connect up to 30 4 ft units together @ 120VAC or 40 4 ft units @ 277VAC
** Only available for G2 models (built-in -EMG emergency battery backup)
